# vendor/yahboom — code gốc Yahboom, giữ nguyên để tham khảo
- `Dofbot/` (tài liệu + Arm_Lib 0.py_install)
- `rosmaster/` (YahboomArm.pyc server + camera.py)
- `dofbot_voice/` (script voice gốc; đã patch ROBOT_ARM_ROOT + fallback)
- `protocol/` (Communication Protocol-Python Library)
Không sửa logic vendor trừ khi cần compat path; code active nằm ở workspaces/ + projects/.
Arm_Lib: `vendor/yahboom/Dofbot/0.py_install` (đã export trong scripts/setup/setup_env.sh).
